name: review-3580
description: fix(syncio): Set errno on EOF in syncRead and propagate to conn->last…
author: abmathur-ie

maintainer_comments.author: madolson
maintainer_comments.body: `connTLSSyncRead`, `connTLSSyncWrite`, and `connTLSSyncReadLine` in tls.c don't set `conn->last_errno` on failure either. `updateStateAfterSSLIO` only sets it for `EINTR`. If the goal is making `connGetLastError()` reliable after sync operations, TLS should be addressed too — at least acknowledged as a follow-up.

maintainer_comments.author: madolson
maintainer_comments.body: Looks like you somehow reverted this, which was a past commit?
